title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
grouping: Three panels side by side - (a) Explicit Policy, (b) Implicit Policy, (c) Diffusion Policy - separated by thin vertical grey rules, each named by a bold sans sub-caption underneath. Inside (a) a blue dashed callout box, reached by a dashed curved arrow from the output circle, lists the action representations; (b) and (c) each pair the block diagram with a square plot on the same o/a axes.
shapes_depth: Flat, square-cornered light-grey boxes with thin black outlines hold each policy's name in bold and its function in large math (F_theta(o), argmin_a(E), grad E(a)); the learned network sits in a dashed inner box inside the grey box. Variables are large circles with thick black outlines (o, a at the bottom; a-hat in light blue at the top), joined by short black arrows. In (c) a dashed loop labelled K iter feeds the network output back to its own a input. The plots are a blue sequential energy heat map with a 0-1 colour bar and a field of small blue triangles (gradient field), both crossed by the same black arc-and-line target curve; the callout in (a) holds three tiny line/bar sketches (Gaussian, mixture, categorical histogram) labelled in blue.
proposed_highlight: No colour singles the method out: the proposed policy is simply the last of three identically built panels, reached after the two alternatives, with its own plot (the gradient field) as the visual payoff.
lesson: Draw each policy class as the same tiny block diagram (input circle, grey box with its equation, output circle) and pair it with a plot of what it learns on one shared toy target, so the panels compare both the computation and its result.
notes: Venue RSS from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); the fetched arXiv PDF is the extended journal version with no venue line; year = arXiv preprint year (2303.04137), which matches RSS 2023. elements 'other' = the triangle-glyph gradient field; 'legend' = the energy colour bar. The energy heat map and gradient-field plot are embedded rasters (recorded by refs crop), so measured photo_share counts them and the palette leaves them out.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
